notes: Notes now auto-expand to fit their content instead of scrolling
Removed the in-app dictate button - use your iPhone keyboard's built-in dictation instead
The trash icon now opens a Delete vs Clear choice, each with a confirmation - Delete removes the bed, Clear resets it (rounding status, to-dos, notes, timer, dispo) for a new patient
Dispo tab retitled to Disposition Overview & Discharge Planning
Reminders tab now shows a tasks-completed-today counter plus a High/Medium/Low breakdown
Adding a to-do now opens a small modal with High/Medium/Low priority buttons instead of a plain text prompt
